map.品牌强度系数代表什么？: What does the brand strength factor represent?
map.品牌收购或授权谈判时，给品牌单独估一个可报价的数。: In a brand acquisition or licensing negotiation, put a separate quotable value on the brand.
map.品牌贡献率怎么定？: How should the brand contribution rate be set?
map.强度系数对估值的影响: The effect of the strength coefficient on valuation
map.用剔除品牌因素前后的利润差除以总利润，或按行业基准（快消约 25%–40%）校准: Divide the profit difference before and after excluding the brand factor by total profit, or calibrate against an industry benchmark (roughly 25%-40% for fast-moving consumer goods); combine this with the company's own history and comparable companies.
